name: Hive 1.5.0
notes: In-app workspace invites. Inviting a teammate by GitHub handle now also delivers a Pending invite to their account inbox — the invite code (with the key) is sealed to their device's key-agreement key, so the relay stays content-blind. The invitee sees a 'Workspace invite' banner and Accepts to join, no code to copy/paste. (Requires the relay's new invite endpoint; until it's deployed, invites still seal the key as before.)
